simple.summary: קְצִיעָה (qᵉtsîyʻâh) means cassia (as peeled; plural the bark) First listed occurrence: Ps 45 9.

definitions.full: H7102. qetsiah I. [ קְצִיעָה ] noun feminine cassia , a powdered bark, like cinnamon (hence Greek κασία , Latin casia , Lewy Fremdw. 37 ); — plural פָצִיעוֺת וַאֲהָלוֺת) (מֹר Psa 45:9 (Che now תּוּצַק are shed , see in Ency. Bib. CASSIA, n .).
